sections.changelog:
1.3.6

  • Repeated all public cache purges for an exactly equivalent read-model retry without rewriting the stored model.
  • Returned a truthful cache receipt and write_changed=false after an equivalent retry succeeds.
  • Kept cache-purge failures fail closed and recoverable with a new signed nonce.
  • Covered response-loss and repeated cache-failure recovery with executable receiver tests.
